name: X-37B OTV-3 (USA-240)
first: USA-240 — 675 days on orbit, Vandenberg AFB
description: Third X-37B flight, reuse of the OTV-1 flight vehicle. Launched 2012-12-11 18:03 UTC from CCAFS SLC-41 on Atlas V 501 AV-034; landed at Vandenberg AFB 2014-10-17 16:24 UTC. 675 days on orbit. Operations interrupted by 16 days when the Antares CRS-3 launch failure on adjacent CCAFS infrastructure briefly hindered USSF support windows.

events.label: LANDING
events.note: Autonomous runway landing at Vandenberg AFB 2014-10-17.
